children.role_hint: Bias generation network. M1 is a diode-connected PMOS that establishes the PMOS current-source gate bias at iref_snk, which biases M2 and M5 in the amplifier stages.

children.role_hint: First gain stage of the LDO error amplifier. M4 and M3 form a PMOS differential input pair comparing reference/input vin against feedback fb. M2 supplies tail bias from the iref_snk bias voltage. M8 and M7 form an NMOS current-mirror active load, producing the single-ended first-stage output at net7.

children.role_hint: Second gain and pass-gate driver stage. M5 is a PMOS current-source load biased by iref_snk, while M6 uses the first-stage output net7 to generate the pass-transistor gate-control voltage net2.

children.role_hint: Series RC Miller/feed-forward compensation network between the first-stage error-amplifier output net7 and the regulated output vo. R0 and C0 shape loop stability and introduce compensation zero/pole behavior.

children.role_hint: Output load capacitor connected from the regulated output vo to ground. It represents the LDO load capacitance and contributes to output filtering and loop dynamics.

children.role_hint: LDO output power stage and feedback sensing network. M0 is the PMOS pass transistor controlled by net2, sourcing current from vdd to the regulated output vo. R1 and R2 form the resistive feedback divider that generates fb from vo for the error amplifier.
